text:
[Council File 15-0315-S11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT , TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to project application for the State of California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) Fiscal Year (FY) 2025-2026 Low Carbon Transit Operations Program (LCTOP).
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. ADOPT the LCTOP Project RESOLUTION as required by Caltrans, included as an Attachment of the Los Angeles Department of Transportation (LADOT) report dated October 2, 2026, attached to the Council file.
2. AUTHORIZE the General Manager, LADOT, to:
a. Apply for and accept funds for Fiscal Year (FY) 2025-26 LCTOP Cycle A grant funds from Caltrans in an amount up to $1,151,725 for costs associated with the procurement of two zero-emission electric buses to be used as part of the DASH transit service.
b. Apply for and accept funds for FY 2025-26 LCTOP Cycle B grant funds from Caltrans in an amount up to $737,903 for costs associated with the procurement of two zero-emission electric buses, being the same vehicles as those mentioned above, to be used as part of the DASH transit service.
3. AUTHORIZE the funds to be deposited into Fund No. 385, account number to be determined, entitled “Purchase of Zero-Emission Electric DASH Buses”, and appropriate therein for the procurement of buses.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The LADOT reports that there is no impact to the City's General Fund since there is no match funding requirement for this project.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Authority for LADOT to apply for State Low Carbon Transit Operations Program funding for fiscal year 2025-26.
